method.controls: Same pinned Halogen 0.12.2, HGN checkpoint and quality overlay; 262144 context, 16384 prefill chunks, one slot, vision on, greedy, seed 1, thinking off, serial, PLD off, cache off. Fresh process per budget. Only the attention budget changes from the earlier serial profile.
method.sequence: 7910-record near-limit retrieval, 959-record control, fixed 13-case suite. The baseline file records the exact prompt generator and model artifacts.
method.runtime_override: One-off wrapper adds -e HALOGEN_INDEXER_BUDGET=4096 or =8192 to the CLI-rendered container command. Normal guarded startup/stop and health checks remain in use. No shipped profile is modified.
method.limits: One process/run per non-default budget and one synthetic near-limit document. Baseline measured earlier in the same session. Timings are observations, not a repeated performance qualification.
